answer: Under retroactive spot audits, every filed task stays a liability for its identity. Earnings enter a river, a vesting stream bound to one key and released slowly. Each epoch an unpredictable beacon signal selects old tasks, and checkers rerun them unannounced. One failure turns that river to tundra: its unvested balance is voided. Streams cannot merge, so a farm pays for genuine work under every head or forfeits each balance separately. Honest work only delays pay; tasks that cannot be rerun escape this check.
